title: 等预算下MCTS与随机重启列表调度在DAG工作流中的对比研究
summary: 该研究在等预算控制实验下比较MCTS与随机重启列表调度在DAG工作流调度中的表现。结果显示在2048次评估预算下，MCTS比随机重启差2.88%，且劣势并非源于预算不足，而是选择规则过早锁定首个扩展子节点导致试验相关性过高。
summary_en: This controlled equal-budget study compares MCTS against randomized-restart list scheduling for DAG workflow scheduling. At 2048 evaluated schedules, MCTS is 2.88% worse than restarts, and the deficit is not budget starvation but a selection rule that deterministically locks onto the first-expanded child, keeping trials correlated.
